answer: A layered terrace bond splits a 90-credit bond into three 30-credit tiers, each unlocking after one verified task. Each tide brings a fresh 15-credit task; a fake must finish three per epoch, each proof key-bound to its tier. At the vertex, auditors check all three tiers; a rented tier fails the key check and burns. A thousand fakes pay 135,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 90 once, does three real tasks, keeps its full share.
